$comment: Generated by node contract/tools/generate.mjs. Edit contract/tools, not these files.
notes: decide: local is {hash, id, lineage} or null; status is the status reply with only contract and controller {hash, id}; metaByHash maps a hash to the config meta answer or refusal current filed for it. expect is the hash a fetch must produce, null for every other decision.

admit: expected is what the decision was made from; currentLocalHash is the applied hash read again from storage after the read; fetched is the canonical hash of the bytes, the hash the reply carried, and the id and lineage of the bytes' own controller block; accepted is section 9.7 under peer intake. Checked in the order headMoved, moved, unverifiable, invalid, inconsistent, adopt.

gate: times are integer milliseconds on one clock. failedAt and held are keyed by the applied hash; settled holds "<applied hash> <remote hash> <agentVersion>" for each remembered admission refusal. The back-off is 60000 ms: a failure exactly 60000 ms ago no longer holds.
pushReply: reply is the parsed config set reply, or null when none was read. metaHash is set only for fileMeta.

decide.name: unsupported-2x-agent
decide.purpose: A 2.x agent sends no contract. It cannot carry the setup and is left out, never shown as a conflict.

decide.name: unsupported-no-controller
decide.purpose: A contract 3 status without a controller block says nothing about the setup, so the machine is left out of this round.

decide.name: unknown-no-local
decide.purpose: This device applies no setup yet. Nothing is pushed or fetched automatically; enrolment is an explicit flow.

decide.name: unknown-local-unidentified
decide.purpose: A document without a setup id gets an identity before it takes part, so until then rule 3 keeps it out.

decide.name: in-sync
decide.purpose: The machine holds exactly the applied document.

decide.name: push-machine-unidentified
decide.purpose: The machine holds a copy nobody claims, pushed without an identity: push over it.

decide.name: different-setup-even-if-in-lineage
decide.purpose: Another setup id wins over a hash this device has seen before: rule 7 comes before rule 8, so a person decides instead of a push replacing somebody else's fleet.

decide.name: push-machine-behind
decide.purpose: The machine holds an ancestor of the applied document: push.

decide.name: read-meta
decide.purpose: The machine holds a revision of this setup that is not an ancestor, and nothing is filed for it: read config meta once, then decide again.

decide.name: fetch
decide.purpose: The filed meta says the machine's copy descends from the applied one: fetch, expecting exactly that hash.

decide.name: diverged
decide.purpose: Neither copy descends from the other: stop at a person.

decide.name: meta-for-another-hash
decide.purpose: Meta filed for a hash the machine held earlier says nothing about what it holds now: read meta again.

decide.name: diverged-33-apart
decide.purpose: The machine is 33 revisions ahead, one more than a lineage carries, so the two look unrelated: that fails toward a question, never toward a loss.

decide.name: meta-id-outranks-status
decide.purpose: The status names this setup but the filed meta, which describes the same bytes, names another: the meta decides.

decide.name: filed-current-fetches
decide.purpose: The current of the stale-revision refusal in push-stale-revision, filed and decided on at once with the status replaced by it: the machine is ahead, so fetch with no extra meta read.

admit.name: adopt
admit.purpose: The bytes hash to what the decision expected, pass section 9.7, carry this setup id and descend from the applied document.

admit.name: moved
admit.purpose: The bytes hash to the reply's own hash but not the expected one: the machine changed between meta and fetch, so decide again on the next status.

admit.name: unverifiable
admit.purpose: The bytes match neither the expected hash nor the reply's: a rebuild from an agent that sends no raw text. Never adopted.

admit.name: invalid
admit.purpose: The right bytes, but section 9.7 refuses them under peer intake.

admit.name: inconsistent-lineage
admit.purpose: The right bytes, whose own lineage does not contain the applied hash, although the meta said it did.

admit.name: inconsistent-id
admit.purpose: The right bytes, whose own controller block names another setup.

admit.name: head-moved-first
admit.purpose: An edit was saved here while the read was suspended. Nothing is written, whatever the bytes are, and the next status decides from the new head.

gate.name: push-acts
gate.purpose: A push with nothing in the way goes out.

gate.name: push-held-running-operation
gate.purpose: The machine's last status lists a running operation: the push waits.

gate.name: push-held-local-mutation
gate.purpose: This device has an action in flight on the machine: the push waits.

gate.name: push-held-until-later-status
gate.purpose: A lock refusal at the same millisecond as the last status: no status read after the refusal has said nothing is running yet.

gate.name: push-after-later-status
gate.purpose: A status read after the lock refusal lists nothing running: the push goes out again.

gate.name: push-backoff-59s
gate.purpose: A failure 59 s ago for this applied hash holds everything automatic.

gate.name: push-backoff-over
gate.purpose: A failure exactly 60 s ago no longer holds anything.

gate.name: backoff-other-hash
gate.purpose: A failure for another applied hash says nothing about this one: a new hash starts afresh.

gate.name: read-meta-during-operation
gate.purpose: Reads are never held for a running operation.

gate.name: fetch-backoff
gate.purpose: The back-off holds reads too.

gate.name: in-flight
gate.purpose: One setup request per machine at a time.

gate.name: read-meta-in-flight
gate.purpose: A read waits for the request in flight like anything else.

gate.name: fetch-settled
gate.purpose: This fetch was refused before for the same two hashes and the same agent: it is not read again.

gate.name: fetch-settled-agent-updated
gate.purpose: The agent was updated since, perhaps to one that sends raw: read again.

gate.name: in-sync-sends-nothing
gate.purpose: A decision that calls for no request sends none, whatever the state.

gate.name: diverged-sends-nothing
gate.purpose: Divergence stops at a person; nothing automatic goes out.

gate.name: push-held-after-refusal
gate.purpose: The machine refused this applied hash with restricted: it is not sent again until the hash changes or a person asks.

gate.name: held-other-hash
gate.purpose: A refusal of another applied hash does not hold this one.

gate.name: push-held-local-invalid
gate.purpose: The applied document has a section 9.7 error: it is not published.

gate.name: fetch-despite-local-invalid
gate.purpose: A device whose own document has an error still reads and fetches, which is how it is repaired.

pushReply.name: push-stored
pushReply.purpose: config.set.stored.json for the hash this device pushed: the failure, if any, is forgotten.

pushReply.name: push-noop
pushReply.purpose: config.set.noop.json: the machine already held exactly these bytes.

reply.message: this machine already holds 3d7251f8; nothing was written

pushReply.name: push-replaced
pushReply.purpose: config.set.replaced.json for the hash this device pushed.

reply.message: setup setup-3f9c2a71 replaced by setup-8b04d193 revision 4, 198 bytes

pushReply.name: push-stored-other-hash
pushReply.purpose: A push that stored something other than the applied document: the machine holds bytes this device did not send, so this is a failure.

pushReply.name: push-stale-revision
pushReply.purpose: config.set.stale-revision.json: the machine is ahead. Its current is filed under its hash and decided on at once (filed-current-fetches).

reply.message: this machine holds 3d7251f8 (revision 12), which descends from the 1c680fab you pushed; fetch it rather than pushing over it

pushReply.name: push-divergent
pushReply.purpose: config.set.conflict-divergent.json: the current is filed, and the next decision says diverged.

reply.message: this machine holds 3d7251f8 revision 12 from mac; the document offered is revision 12 and neither descends from the other, so both edits are still here and somebody has to merge them

pushReply.name: push-operation-in-progress
pushReply.purpose: config.set.locked.json: an update holds the lock; push again once a later status lists nothing running.

reply.message: an update of t3 has held the lock since 2026-09-05T14:00:01.000Z; the setup was not changed, and this push can be retried when it finishes

pushReply.name: push-lock-held
pushReply.purpose: The lock refusal under its other code.

reply.message: an update of t3 has held the lock since 2026-09-05T14:00:01.000Z; the setup was not changed, and this push can be retried when it finishes

pushReply.name: push-no-reply
pushReply.purpose: No reply was read: the link dropped or the command timed out. The push may have landed or not; back off and decide from the next status.

pushReply.name: push-bad-argument
pushReply.purpose: config.set.bad-argument.json carries current too, but only stale-revision and controller-conflict are filed: this is a failure.

reply.message: --revision 13 does not match controller.revision 12 in the document on stdin; nothing was written

pushReply.name: push-restricted
pushReply.purpose: config.set.restricted-launch.json: this key may not publish these launch values, and trying again cannot change that.

reply.message: this key is restricted, and the document carries a launch value this machine does not hold (machines[tower].systems[linux]); publish it from a device whose key is not restricted

pushReply.name: push-config-invalid
pushReply.purpose: config.set.invalid-document.json: the agent refused the document's structure.

reply.message: the document breaks 1 rule of the setup document, so nothing was written; the first is machines[0].endpoints[0].host

problems.message: is not a host name or an address, so no client may hand it to ssh

pushReply.name: push-internal
pushReply.purpose: An internal refusal is a failure to back off from.

reply.message: the setup could not be written; nothing was changed
